## Purpose and scope
What user problem does this solve? Link any related issue or research source.

## Verification
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] UI changes: mobile, keyboard, focus, and contrast reviewed

## Security / trust-boundary review
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, secrets, personal or confidential customer data
- [ ] New dependencies and third-party calls reviewed
- [ ] Auth, authorization, inputs, external URLs, and SSRF considered if affected
- [ ] Crawled content / AI output treated as untrusted; publication requires review
- [ ] Source citations, licenses, data freshness, and Unknown states preserved
- [ ] Documented any risks not covered by automated tests

## Learning note
What changed, what was tested, and what did you learn?

## Research changes (N/A for unrelated changes)
- [ ] Followed [Contributing research](../CONTRIBUTING.md); linked a completed review record
- [ ] Checked parent/product/alias history; preserved stable IDs and unknown dates
- [ ] `npm run test:research-integrity`
- [ ] Owner, reviewer, next review date and rights constraints recorded
- [ ] Recorded current stage: researched / reviewed / checks passed / merged / published and verified
- [ ] Deployment evidence or docs-only N/A recorded; no claim of publication from CI alone
